tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i dbang gi cho ga bzhugs//

༄༅// dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga nyi shu pa'i snying po gsal ba zhes bya ba/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo// phung po khams rnams sangs rgyas lha mor rnam dag cing*// skye mched rnams ni sems dpa' sems ma'i rang bzhin te// las dbang byed pa khro bo bcu yi ngo bo nyid// sum cu so gnyis dkyil 'khor de la phyag 'tshal nas// dpal ldan 'dus pa'i lam gyis ni// smin byed dbang gi rim pa rnams// 'phags mchog klu grub mthu yis ni// gsal mdzad lag len bshad par bya// 'dir dbang bskur bar byed pa la gsum ste// gang gis bskur ba'i slob dpon dang*// gang la bskur ba'i slob ma dang*/ ji ltar bskur ba'i cho ༄༅// ga'o// dang po ni yon tan thams cad dang ldan pa// rim pa gnyis kyi don shes dang*// mchog dang thun mong bsgrub la gnas// dam tshig sdom la gnas pa ste// rtsa ba'i ltung ba rnam par spangs// bzod ldan drang zhing g.yo rgyu med// brtan zhing dul la blo gros ldan// sngags dang rgyud kyi sbyor ba shes// de nyid bcu ni yongs shes shing*// rab gnas sbyin bsreg dkyil 'khor mkhas// nyan thos rnams kyi lam 'gro min// pha rol phyin bcu'i tshul la gnas// zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsungs pa'i mtshan nyid can gyis/ slob ma legs par brtags pa rin po che lta bu yongs su rdzogs pa'i snod dang*/ gzhan rnams la ni ci rigs par sbyin no// dbang dngos la gsum// sngon du bsnyen pa bya ba dang*// yan lag nyi shu mdor bstan pa dang*/ rgyas par bshad pa'o// bsnyen pa ni mtshan ma'i bsnyen pa'am// grangs ni dkyil 'khor gtso bo'i bzlas pa 'bum// de las gzhan pa khri ru bzlas// zhes so// gnyis pa ni sa gzhi sbyang dang byin brlabs dang*// yongs su bzung dang bsrung ba dang*// sa'i lha dang dkyil 'khor lha// bum pa rnams dang slob ma dag /sta gon du ni gnas pa dang*/

thig gdab pa yi cho ga dang*// de bzhin rdul tshon dgyes pa dang*// dkyil 'khor byin gyis brlab pa dang*// de la mchod pa'i bye brag dang*// slob dpon bdag nyid 'jug pa dang*// de bzhin slob ma gzhug pa dang*/ bum pa'i dbang dang gsang ba'i dbang*// shes rab ye shes dbang dang ni// de bzhin du ni bzhi pa dang*// rab gnas dang ni sbyin bsreg ste// dkyil 'khor gyi ni yan lag mchog /'di ni cho ga nyi shu'o// zhes nub dang po dang gnyis pa la brgyad/ gsum pa la bcu/ rab gnas sbyin bsreg /gnyis dang nyi shu yod pa las/ dang po sa sbyang ba la yang bzhi ste/ dang po snyan gsan dbab pa'i don du dkyil 'khor gang du byed pa'i sa der maṇ+ḍal gru bzhi khru gang ba byas te/ me tog bkram la lha'i gdan du bsams te/ dkyil 'khor bskyed la mchod pa'i bar byas la bstod nas// dgongs shig dus gsum mgon po rnams// sangs rgyas thams cad ༄༅// mchod pa dang*// slob ma rnams la phan don du// bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yis// dpal ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa yi// dkyil 'khor dam pa 'bri bar 'tshal// rgyal ba sras dang bcas rnams kyis// bdag la byin gyis brlab tu gsol// zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab po// de nas gnyis pa phyogs skyong rnams bskyed la/ mchod yon la sogs pa'i mchod pa dang gtor ma yang byin gyis brlabs nas/ oṃ in tra ye swāhā/ ya ma ye swāhā/ bā ru na ye swāhā/ ku be ra ye swāhā/ ag na ye swāhā/ ni ri te rak+ta san ti pa ta ye swāhā/ bā ya bhe ye swāhā/ i sha na ye swāhā/ oṃ tsan tra ye swāhā/ sur d+ya ye swāhā/ pri ti bh+ya swāhā/ oṃ a ka ro mu khaṃ sarba dharma naṃ/ ad+ya nud pan n+yad tad ta oṃ ā hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes gtor ma phul la/ khams gsum gnas pa'i lha dang klu// gnod sbyin dri za lha ma yin// gang dag rdzu 'phrul che rnams ldan/ rdo rje spyan dang snyan mnga' ba// 'byung la gnas pa'i 'byung po rnams// bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yis// sangs rgyas rnams la mchod pa dang*// sems can rnams la phan don du// sa phyogs dge gnas 'di nyid du/

dam pa'i dkyil 'khor cher 'byung ba// ji ltar bsams pa'i las byed na// khyed kyis bar chad ma byed par// dge ba'i grogs po nyid du mdzod// de ltar khyod la bdag gis ni// bzod par gsol gyis ma bslu bar/ rmi lam la sogs mtshan ma rnams// legs nyes las rnams bstan du gsol// zhes lan gsum du brjod na gzhi bdag la yang gtor ma sbyin no// de nas gsum pa bgegs zhi bar bya ba'i phyir dri'i chu la las thams cad pa'i sngags 'di bzlas te/ oṃ na mā sa man ta ka ya bāg tsi ta badz+ra nan/ na mo badz+ra kro ta ya/ ma ha daṃ ṣ+ṭod ka ra bhe ra bha ya/ a si mu sa la/ pa ra shu pa ta sha ha ta ya/ oṃ armi ta kun dha li/ ha hā kha kha khā hi khā hi/ tiṣ+ṭa tiṣ+ṭa/ bhan dha bhan dha/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ gar dza gar dza/ bī yo ta ya bī yo ta ya/ sarba big nan/ bhi na ya ka nan/ ma hā gha na pa ti/ dzi bi ta yan ta ka ra ya/ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes lan gsum bzlas te gtor bar bya'o// lcogs na sbyin bsreg dang*/ gnod mdzes kyi sngags kyis mi rus kyi sbyin bsreg kyang byas te bgegs sbyang ba'o// bzhi pa las dang bya bas sbyang ba ni/ zabs su rkos la rus pa dang sol ba la sogs pa'i skyon bsal la/ rin po che dang sman la sogs pa bcug cing stegs bu legs par byas te sa la ma lhung ba'i lci ba dang dri zhim pos byug go /de nas sbyor ba gsum gyis ting nge 'dzin bsgom pa ni sa sbyang ba'o/ gnyis pa sa byin gyis brlab pa ni/ hūm̐ kham̐ hūm̐ zhes rnam par dag par bsams la/ hūm̐ sum̐ hūm̐ la rin po che bzhi'i ri rab tu bsgoms te/ hūm̐ lam̐ hūm̐ las gser gyi sa gzhi gru bzhi la rdo rje'i phreng bas brgyan par ༄༅// bsgoms te/ lag pa thal mo kha sbub la/ oṃ me dhi ni badz+ra bha badz+ra bhan dha hūm̐ zhes brjod nas byin gyis brlab po/ nub dang po'i bya ba'o// de nas nub gnyis pa'i snga dro sa bzung ba ni/

dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su bdag nyid kyis dang po'i sbyor bas zhe sdang rdo rje bsgoms la/ las byed pas rnam snang la sogs pa'i sangs rgyas bzhi'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas pas/ mchod pa byas te bskul ba ni/ shar nas de bzhin gshegs pa kun zhi ba// de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas// chos kun bdag med pa yi mchog /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol// lho nas/ mtshan rnams thams cad yongs su rdzogs// mtshan min thams cad rnam par spangs// kun tu bzang po sku'i mchog /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol// nub nas/ zhi ba'i chos ni mchog las byung*// ye shes spyod pa rnam sbyong ba// kun du bzang po gsung gi mchog dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol// byang nas/ sems can kun gyi sems chen po// rang bzhin dag pa dri ma med// kun bzang thugs mchog kha lo bsgyur// dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol// zhes gsol ba btab nas rang nyid zhe sdang rdo rje khro bo chen po'i mig g.yas g.yon du ma dang ta las/ nyi ma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su hūm̐ las 'od 'bar ba'i zer gyis thams cad khro bo'i dkyil 'khor du bsams te/ rkang pa a las sna tshogs rdo rjer bsgoms la rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas g.yo bag tu langs la 'di skad du brjod do// sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje can// sangs rgyas thams cad bdag la gson// bdag ni dpal ldan rdo rje 'dzin// bka' yi 'khor lo rab sbyor gyis// lha dang lha min gsang ba pa// brjed byed la sogs bgegs kyi tshogs// sa 'dir ma 'dug gzhan du dengs// gal te dam tshig las 'da' na// rdo rje khro bo bzhin 'bar ba'i// rdo rje rab tu 'bar ba yis// mgo ni tshal pa brgyar 'gas shing*// zhig par 'gyur ba gdon mi za// zhes brjod nas dbang ldan gyi mtshams su song ste/ bdag rdo rje slob dpon ming 'di zhes bya bas sems can gyi don du dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor bri bar byed pas/

gang su dag lha dang mi dang lha ma yin dang*/ gnod sbyin dang*/ srin po dang*/ yi dwags dang*/ sha za dang*/ brjed byed dang*/ 'byung po dang*/ nam mkha' lding dang*/ mi'am ci dang*/ rig 'dzin la sogs pa rgan po dang rgan mo dang 'khor dang g.yog tu bcas pa rnams/ rdo rje 'dzin pa'i bka' thos nas myur du dengs shig /gang dag mi 'gro ba de dag ni khro bo'i rdo rje rab tu 'bar bas mgo bo brgyar 'gas par 'gyur ro// zhes brjod nas/ rdo rje'i 'gros kyis dkyil 'khor la lan gsum du bskor ro/ 'dir brjod pa/ rtse cig rtse gsum rtse lnga pa yi// rdo rje gom pas ༄༅// bskor bar bya// shar du g.yas brkyang dbyug 'phen te// lho ru g.yon brkyang mda' 'phen stabs// nub tu sa ga pad ma ste// byang dang zlum po gtun shing 'dzin// dbus su pad ma zhi ba dang*// hūm̐ zhes rdo rje'i gar gyis bskor// sa bzung ba'i cho ga'o// de nas sa bsrung ba ni/ seng ldeng la sogs pa'i phur pa dris byugs la srad bu dmar po dang me tog gi phreng ba can bcu la khro bo'i tshogs bskyed la phyogs mtshams su phur bus gdab par bya ste/ suṃ bha ni yi sngags brjod nas rdo rje'i sa gzhi dang ra ba dang gur byas te/ oṃ ta ki ra tsa hūm̐ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ zhes brjod nas zhal gsum phyag drug pa smad phur bu'i rnam pas phyogs bcu'i gdon la gdab ste/ oṃ gha gha gha ta ya sarba du stan phaṭa phaṭa ki la ya kī la ya sarba pa pam̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ badz+ra dha ra ang dzñā pa ya ti/ sarba big nan ka ya bag tsi ta badz+ra ki la ya hūm̐ phaṭa zhes btab la/ oṃ badz+ra mud ka ra badz+ra ki la ya/ a ko ṭa ya a ko ṭa ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes rdo rje tho bas brdungs nas bde ba chen por bya'o// sa bsrung ba'o// lnga pa sa'i lha mo'i lhag gnas ni/ bdag gis mi skyod pa'i phyag rgya sa la bzhag ste/ oṃ ta ki hūm̐ zhes brjod pas/

laṃ las sa yi lha mo ser mo rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa rnam snang gi dbu rgyan can phyag na gser gyi bum pa 'dzin pa sa las dgug ste/ oṃ tshur spyon tshur spyon lha mo che// sa yi lha mo bum 'dzin yum// rin chen kun gyis rab gang ba// bzang po'i rgyan gyis rnam par brgyan// do shal rkang gdub sgra ldan ma// rdo rje sems dpas rab mchod ma// mchod yon 'di ni bzhes nas kyang*// dkyil 'khor las ni grub par mdzod// dza hūm̐ bam̐ ho hi/ oṃ pra ti dhi bī argaṃ/ pa t+yaṃ/ a dza ma naṃ/ pro khya ma naṃ pra ti ts+tsha ye swāhā/ zhes pa dang*/ mchod pa rnams kyang phul nas/ bstod pa dang*/ bha ling phul nas/ gsol ba gdab pa ni/ skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad par gyi// sa dang pha rol phyin pa la// lha mo khyod ni dpang du gyur// shākya seng ge skyob pa yis// ci ltar bdud kyi sde bcom pa// de bzhin bdag gis bdud kyi sde// pham par byas te dkyil 'khor bri// zhes brjod nas de nyid du thim par bsam mo// sa'i lha mo lhag gnas cho ga'o// drug pa dkyil 'khor gyi lha lhag par gnas pa ni/ maṇ+ḍal gyi dbus su dri zhim pos thig le lha grangs mnyam par byas la/ bskyed chog rgyas par byas te/ phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pas mchod cing bstod pas bstod la/ lag tu bdug spos thogs nas gsol ba gdab pa ni/ bcom ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa mchog /rigs sngags rgyal la phyag 'tshal lo// thugs rje'i bdag nyid can rnams kyi// dkyil 'khor bdag ni bri bar 'tshal// slob ma rnams la brtse ba dang*/ khyed rnams la yang mchod pa'i phyir// bcom ldan ༄༅// bdag ni gus pa la/ deng ni gnang bar mdzad pa'i rigs// sangs rgyas 'gro 'khor bya don stsol// byang chub sems dpa' 'bras gnas dang*// gang gzhan gsang sngags lha rnams dang*// 'jig rten skyong ba'i lha rnams dang*// gang yang 'byung po mthu chen dang*/

gang yang rdo rje'i spyan mnga' ba'i// sems can bstan la dga' ba rnams// bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yis// rdo rje 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor ni// yo byad ci 'byor pas bri na// deng bdag slob mar bcas pa la// thugs brtse bar ni dgongs nas su// tshogs pa thams cad dkyil 'khor du// byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol// zhes lan gsum du brjod do// lha sta gon gyi cho ga'o// bdun pa bum pa lhag gnas ni/ gser la sogs pa'i bum pa mtshan nyid dang ldan pa lha grangs dang mnyam pa'am/ drug gam gnyis kyang rung te/ phyag mtshan bris pas brgyan la mgul chings dang kha rgyan byas te/ gu gul gyis bdug cing suṃ bha nis bsangs la/ dri bzang po'i chu dkar mngar dang bcas pas bkang la/ gro dang*/ nas dang*/ til dang 'bras dang so ba dang mon sran te 'bru lnga dang*/ byi ru sa le sbram dang*/ dung dang mu tig dang*/ nor bu ste rin po che lnga dang*/ sing ha bh+ya kri/ ha sa/ ha sa dhe ba/ kar ni ka ste sman lnga blugs la/ kha rgyan gyi gseb tu bdud rtsi lnga'i chu dang bcas pa'i dung chos bzhag ste rdo rje gzungs thag btags nas/ bdag nyid bskyed pa'i rim pa la gnas pas/ yi ge bam̐ las byung ba'i gser gyi bum par hri las gyur pa'i pad ma dang a las byung ba'i nyi zla'i gdan la rang rang gi mngon rtogs ltar bskyed la ye shes dgug gzhug dang mchod bstod gtor ma yang phul te/ oṃ badz+ra dh+rig swā hā la sogs pa'i lha so so'i bzlas pa byas nas gsol ba gtab ste/ oṃ badz+ra u ta ke hūm̐ gis chu blangs la bzhu bar bya'o// las thams cad pa yang bskyed cing bzlas pa mchod de bgegs bzlog pa'i gsol ba gdab bo// bum pa lta gon no// skabs 'dir dbu rgyan dang rdo rje dril bu dang dbang gi yo byad gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa'i 'grel pa las bshad pa bzhin byin gyis brlabs na legs par rtogs so// brgyad pa slob ma lhag gnas ni bcu gsum las/

khrus bya zhing maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba dang*/ gsol ba gdab pa dang*/ nyan par bskul ba dang*/ lnga rnam dag skyabs 'gro sems bskyed dang bcas pa dang*/ sdom pa bsgrags pa dang*/ khas blangs pa dang*/ gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs te mchod pa dang*/ so shing sbyin pa dang*/ skyor chu dang*/ bsrung skud dang*/ ku sha sbyin pa dang*/ chos bshad pa dang*/ rmi lam brtag pa rjes kyi bya ba dang bcas pa'o// dang po ni slob ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa rnams las kyi bum pas phyi rol du khrus byas la/ maṇ+ḍal gyi cho ga gang yang rung ༄༅// bas maṇ+ḍal phul nas 'byung po thams cad pa'i gtor ma yang btang ste/ gnyis pa slob dpon gyis/ khyed rnams dal 'byor thob par dka' ba thob cing bstan pa dam pa dang mjal/ de las kyang tshe gcig lus gcig gis sangs rgyas thob par byed pa rdo rje theg pa bla na med pa gsang ba 'dus par 'jug par byed pa shin tu legs te/ 'di yang rgyud las dbang gis smin byas dam tshig ldan/ bskyed pa'i rim la legs gnas shing*// rdzogs pa'i rim pa 'dod rnams la// thabs 'di rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis// skas kyi rim pa lta bur gsungs/ zhes byung bas thog mar maṇ+ḍal mchod pa'i bye brag lus longs spyod dang bcas pa 'bul zhing gsol ba gdab snyam pas lad mo mdzod cig /dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa pas// slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol// byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa'i// mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo// dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol// byang chub sems ni bdag la stsol// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la stsol// thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu// mgon pos bdag ni 'jug par 'tshal// zhes lan gsum mo// de nas gsum pa nyan par bskul ba ni/ slob dpon gyis/ bu tshur theg pa chen po yi// khyod ni tshul chen snod yin te// gsang sngags spyod tshul cho ga dag /khyod la yang dag bstan par bya// dus gsum byung ba'i sangs rgyas rnams// sku gsum thugs kyi rdo rje can// rdo rje rab sngags bsgoms pa yis// dpa' bos byang chub shing drung du// thams cad mkhyen pa mtshan med brnyes/

gsang sngags sbyor ba mnyam med de// shākya seng ge skyob pa yis// bdud sde shin tu mi zad pa// dpung chen dag kyang de yis bcom// 'jig rten rjes 'jug rtogs nas su// 'khor lo bskor nas mya ngan 'das// de bas kun mkhyen thob bya'i phyir// bu yis blo gros 'di gyis shig /ces bstan la don yang bshad par bya'o// bzhi pa lnga rnam dag skyabs 'gro sems bskyed dang bcas pa ni/ mdun gyi nam mkhar sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams dmigs te lus gus pas phyag 'tshal/ lus longs spyod dang bcas pa ni 'bul/ thog ma med pa nas kyi lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig pa thams cad ni bshags/ so so'i skyo bo dang nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs la rjes su yid rang*/ sangs rgyas chos mi gsung ba rnams la chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul/ mya ngan las mi 'da' bar ni gsol ba 'debs/ bla na med pa'i sangs rgyas dang theg pa chen po'i chos dang*/ rgyal ba 'i sras dge 'dun thams cad la ni/ sems can thams cad kyi don du skyabs su 'gro zhing sems bskyed/ de

༄༅// thams cad kyang byang chub mchog tu gyur cig snyam pas lad mo byed du bcug ste/ bdag gis sdig pa gang bgyis dang*// bgyid du stsal dang yid rang ba// sangs rgyas spyan sngar mchis nas ni// de dag thams cad ni bshags par bgyi// sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ rang rgyal dgra bcom 'gro rnams kyis// bsgom dang bzlas brjod bsod nams gang*// de la bdag ni yid rang ngo*/ phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i rgyal ba la// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul// mya ngan 'da' bar bzhed rnams la// dus kun bzhugs par gsol bar bgyid// sems bskyed mngon par sangs rgyas dang*// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang*// byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyi mchog /de la bdag ni skyabs su mchi// sangs rgyas 'byung ba ci lta bar// skal ldan byang chub sems dpa' yis// byang chub sems ni bskyed pa ltar// de bzhin du ni sems bskyed do// bdag gi dge ba'i las rnams 'di dag gis// 'jig rten 'dir ni myur du sangs rgyas shing*// 'gro la phan phyir chos rnams ston bgyid cing*// sems can sdug bsngal mang pos gzir las bsgrol// zhes lan gsum du brjod do// lnga pa sdom pa sgrag pa ni/ 'di ltar sngags kyi theg par mi dge ba thams cad las bzlog cing bsrung bar bya ba lnga la sogs pa la slob pa dang*/ rigs lnga'i sdom pa rnams bsrung dgos pas 'di rnams bsrung bar nus mi nus bsgrags par bya yis nyon cig /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su song*// 'di ni sangs rgyas rigs dag pa'i// sdom pa brtan par 'gyur ba'o// rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya dag /blo chen khyod kyis bzung bar bya// byang chub sems gang de rdo rje// shes rab dril bu zhes bshad do// slob dpon dag kyang bzung bar bya// bla ma sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam// 'di ni rdo rje'i rigs dag pa'i// dam tshig sdom pa yin par gsungs// rin chen rigs mchog chen po la// nyin dang mtshan mo lan gsum du// zang zing mi 'jigs chos dang byams// sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin// phyi nang gsang ba'i theg pa gsum// dam chos so sor bzung bar gyis// 'di ni pad ma'i rigs dag pa'i// dam tshig sdom pa yin par gsungs// las kyi rigs mchog chen po la// sdom pa thams cad ldan pa ni// yang dag nyid du bzung bar gyis// mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus gyis// srog chags rnams kyang bsad mi bya// ma byin par yang mi blang ngo*// 'dod log dag kyang mi bya zhing*// brdzun du smra bar mi bya'o//

nyes pa kun gyi rtsa ba yi// chang ni rnam par spang bar bya// sems can 'dul bya ma gtogs pa/ bya ba ma yin thams cad spang*// dam pa nye bar bsten bya zhing*// rnal 'byor can kun bsnyen bskur bya// lus kyi las ni ༄༅// rnam gsum dang*// ngag gi rnam pa bzhi dag dang*// yid kyi rnam pa gsum dag ni// ci nus pas ni rjes su bsrung*// sems can don la rgyab mi phyogs// theg pa dman la 'dod mi bya/ 'khor ba dag kyang yongs mi spang*// rtag tu mya ngan 'das mi bya// lha dang lha min gsang ba pa// de la brnyas par mi bya zhing*// phyag rgya zhon pa mtshon cha dang*// mtshan ma 'gong bar mi bya'o// de ltar dam tshig gsungs pa dag /blo ldan khyod kyis rtag tu bsrung*// zhes bsgrags nas/ drug pa de ltar thams cad bzung mi nus na ni sangs rgyas mchog gi sdom pa rkyang sbyin no// thams cad gzung nus na ni gsol ba gdab ste/ 'khor lo phyir mi ldog pa'i dbang*// dam pa bdag la stsal nas ni// mgon po 'khor lo lha dag gi /de nyid slob dpon 'phrin las dang*// sangs rgyas kun gyi dam tshig dang*// sdom pa gsang mchog bshad du gsol// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// bdag ni rtag tu slob dpon bgyis// ces gsol nas/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' rnams// ma lus bdag la dgongs su gsol// bdag gis dus 'di nas bzung nas/ byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar// ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams// byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa// byang chub sems ni bla na med// dam pa bdag gis bskyed par gyi// tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang*// dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang*// sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum// bdag gis brtan por bzung por bgyi// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum// sdom pa sangs rgyas rnal 'byor 'byung*/ deng nas brtsams te bzung bar bgyi// rdo rje rigs mchog chen po la// rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya yang*// de nyid kyis ni bzung bar bgyi// slob dpon dag kyang bzung bar bgyi// rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi// dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la// nyin re bzhin du dus drug tu// sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin// pad ma chen po'i rigs dag pa'i// byang chub chen po 'byung ba la// phyi dang gsang ba'i theg pa gsum// dam chos so sor bzung par bgyi// las kyi rigs chen bsdus pa la// sdom pa thams cad yang dag ldan// mchod pa'i las rnams ci nus bzhin// kun nas so sor bzung bar bgyi// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// byang chub sems ni bla na med// dam pa bdag gis bskyed bgyis shing*// sdom pa ma lus bzung bgyis nas// ma rgal ba rnams bsgral bar bgyi// ma grol ba rnams bdag gis dgrol/

dbugs ma phyung rnams dbugs dbyung zhing*// sems can mya ngan 'das la dgod// gzhan yang lus ngag yid dag gi /mi dge ba ni bcu po dang*// bag med pa yi gnas gyur pa'i/ chang ni rnam par spang bar bya// de bzhin lha dang lha min dang*// gsang ba ༄༅// pa dag brnyas pa dang*// mtshan ma la sogs 'gom pa rnams// dus 'di nas ni bzung nas ni// ci srid byang chub snying po'i bar// bdag ni rab tu ldog par bgyi// zhes brjod de de rnams kyi don yang bshad do// bdun pa gnas gsum byin gyi brlab pa ni/ spyi bor zla ba la oṃ/ mgrin par pad ma la āḥ snying khar nyi ma la hūm̐ bsgom du bcug nas/ dri yi chus thig le bkod cing*/ mchod pa ni/ me tog la sogs pas mchod la/ dus 'di nas ni bzung nas su// 'khor ba'i nyes pas ma gos par// mchod pa kun dang ldan par ni// dus kun du ni bde bar nos// zhes brjod do// brgyad pa so shing ni 'o ma can la sogs pa'i shing sor bcu gnyis pa me tog gi phreng ba can la/ oṃ armi ta kun ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa kyis byin gyis brlabs la/ lci ba dang dris byugs pa'i maṇ+ḍal la dor du gzhug ste/ mi smra bar rtse mo bca' zhing dor ro// mtshan ma ni/ shar lho phyogs bzhi rim pa ltar// zhi rgyas dbang dang drag po 'grub// steng 'og mkha' spyod sa spyod deng*// 'tshams su phra mo'i grub pa 'thob// zhes so// dgu pa ngag gi nyes pa sbyang ba'i skyor chu ni/ oṃ hri bī shud dha ya sarba dharma ya sarba pa paṃ nis tsa ya s+yar sho dha ya sarba bhi ka la pa a pa na ya hūm̐ zhes khyor bar 'thung du gzhug go /bcu pa bsrung skud ni las thams cad pa'am rtsa ba'i sngags kyis mdud pa byas pa'i skud pa dmar po dpung pa la bcings te/ oṃ bhu da me tri rak+ṣa rak+ṣa sarban du swāhā/ zhes brjod do// bcu cig pa ku sha sbyin pa ni rmi lam brtag pa'i don du/

badz+ra dhik+ṣa baṃ gis ku sha'i chun po gnyis byin te/ gcig sngas gcig stan du byas te nyol cig ces bya'o// bcu gnyis pa chos bstan pa ni/ 'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen rnams// u dum bha ra'i me tog bzhin// rgya lam na ni res 'ga' zhig /'byung 'gyur yang ni mi 'byung ngo*// gsang sngags spyod pa'i tshul 'byung ba// de bas kyang ni dkon pa ste// gang gis mnyam med sems can don// mya ngan mi 'da' byed par nus// skal pa bye ba du ma ru// sdig pa byas par gyur pa gang*// de kun dkyil 'khor 'di 'dra ba// mthong bas byang bar 'gyur la gsan// grags pa mtha' yas sngags spyod pa'i// tshul la gnas na smos ci dgos// skyob pa'i gsang sngags 'di bzlas na// go 'phang bla na med par 'gyur// gang dag spyod pa'i mchog 'di la// blo gros brtan mchog mi g.yo ba// de dag gis ni ngan 'gro'i rgyu// sdug bsngal kun 'byung rab tu spyad// bdag nyid chen po khyed rnams kyis// rnyed pa mnyam med de ring rnyed// gang phyir rgyal ba sras bcas la// bdag nyid chen po kun gyis ni// bstan pa 'di la khyed rnams kun// yongs su bzung ste skye bzhin pa// de phyir khyed rnams theg chen la// sa ni rab tu skye bar 'gyur// theg pa chen po cher ༄༅// 'byung ba'i// lam mchog 'di ni dpal dang ldan// khyed rnams der ni dong ba la// rang byung skal pa chen po pa// 'jig rten thams cad mkhyen pa yi// de bzhin gshegs pa rnams su 'gyur// yod dang med las rnam par 'das// nam mkha' bzhin du dri ma med// zab mo rtog ge thams cad kyi// rab tu mi rtogs gnas med pa'o// spros pa kun dang bral ba ste// rtog pa rnams kyi spros pa rnams/ las dang bya ba la sogs bral// bden pa gnyis la gnas pa ste// theg pa rab kyi mchog 'di yi// tshul la gnas na thob par 'gyur/ zhes bya ba'i don yang cung zad bshad do// bcu gsum pa ni rmi lam bzang po ni dge ste dngos grub thob la/

ngan na gtor ma byin la sngags kyis bzlog par bya'o// de nas ci 'byor pa'i mchod pa byas la bsrung bar bya'o// slob ma lhag pa gnas pa'i cho ga'o// cho ga brgyad kyis sngon du 'gro ba'o/ dngos gzhi la bcu bzhi yis dkyil 'khor gyi bya ba ston te/ dang po thig gdab pa ni/ thig skud gnyis byas te ye shes kyi thig la skud pa kha dog lnga pa lnga la/ rang gi mig nas de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi ye shes kyi skud pa dzas bkug ste las thams cad pa'i chus gtor la/ mchod pa yang phul nas oṃ ā oṃ hūm̐/ oṃ a a hūm̐/ oṃ a swā hūm̐/ oṃ a ha hūm̐/ oṃ a hūm̐ hūm̐/ zhes kha khar bsgril la/ oṃ a n+yo na a nud gha da sarba dha rma/ s+pha ra s+pha ra ā nud gha ta sarba dharma a t+yad a nud ga ta sarba dharma aḥ d+yad a nud pra be sha ya sarba dharma hūm̐/ zhes gcig tu bsgril lo// las kyi thig skud kha dog gcig pa yang byas te/ nam mkhar ye shes kyi thig slob dpon kha shar du bltas nas brkyang te/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya su tra ma ti kra ma hūm̐/ zhes brjod la gdab po// de bzhin du lho byang dang mtshams kyang gdab ste/ de nas las kyi skud pas gdab po/ cha chen nyi shu la sogs pa/ cha phran dang bcas legs par gdab// gru bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa// rta babs bzhi yis rnam par brgyan/ thig bzhi dang ni yang dag ldan// ka ba brgyad kyis nye bar mdzes/ zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsungs te lag len ltar bya'o/ gnyis pa rdul tshon ni/ rin po che lnga'am 'bras kha dog bsgyur ba la sogs pa la/ sa bon lnga bkod nas ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin du dgug cing mchod la oṃ badz+ra tsi trang sa ma ya ma ti kra ma hūm̐/ zhes brjod cing byin gyis brlabs nas/ chos dbyings 'di ni rnam par dag /sems can khams ni rnam sgrol mdzad// rdo rje 'dzin pa rgyal po che// rdul tshon mi phyed ngo bo nyid/ zhes g.yon pa'i khu tshur gyis phyi rol nas dkar ser dmar ljang nag po'i re ga byas te/

de nas dbus nas bri bar bya'o// dbus mthing kha/ shar dkar lho ser nus dmar byang ljang ba re mig gi gdung dang ka ba mthing kha'o// 'dod yon dmar po la pha gu ser po dra ba dra ༄༅// phyed mthing kha pu shu mdzes pa rta babs sna tshogs pad ma dang rdo rje dur khrod 'od kyi phreng ba dang bcas pa mdzes par byas te bri'o// de nas phyag mtshan dgos pa ni/ dbus su pad ma dang nyi zla'i steng du rdo rje rtse dgu pa'o// shar du 'khor lo/ lhor rin chen/ nub tu pad ma/ byang du ral gri /mtshams bar ud pa la'o// snam bu gra bzhir/ me long*/ pi wang*/ dung chos/ ro'i snod do// khyams kyi byams pa klu shing gzhan gtso bo dang mthun pa'o// khro bo rnams kyi shar sgor dbyug tho/ lhor rdo rje dbyug pa/ nub pad ma'i dbyug pa/ byang du rgya gram/ mer ral gri/ lho nub lcags kyu/ rlung du rdo rje dbyug pa/ byang shar du tri shu la'o// nub smad du rdo rje te/ thams cad rang rang gi sngags bzlas shing dgod do// dkyil 'khor bri ba'o// gsum pa byin gyi brlabs pa ni/ mchod pa thams cad kyis bskor zhing brgyan la bum pa dang dbang rdzas thams cad kyang bkod la rdo rje slob dpon bdag nyid dang po'i sbyor ba bsgom zhing*/ badz+ra dh+rig la sogs pa'i sngags kyis 'byin pa'i sbyor bas dkyil 'khor bskyed nas phyag rgya bzhi dgod pa'i bar du bya ste/ ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor dgug cing gzhug pa dang bcing ba dang dbang du byas nas/ sems dpa' sum rtseg tu byin gyis brlab po/ bzhi pa mchod pa ni/ dang por me tog la sogs pa phyi'i mchod pas mchod do// de nas reg bya rdo rje sbyor bas sangs rgyas thams cad la mchod pa ni nang gi mchod pa'o// de nas sha lnga dang bdud rtsi lnga sbyangs nas dkyil 'khor la mchod de rang yang tshim par bya ba ni gsang ba'i mchod pa'o// de nas bstod pa dang bzlas pas mnyes par bya ste/

phyir phyogs skyong rnams la gtor ma sbyin no// yang dkyil 'khor gyi nang du song ste/ stod g.yogs dang smad g.yogs dang gtsug gtor la sogs pa'i rgyan thams cad dang ldan pas hūm̐ mdzad kyi skur bsgyur la/ g.yas phyogs nas dkyil 'khor la lan gsum du bskor la/ phyag byas nas me tog gi phreng ba sngon la gtso bo la phul te/ slar blangs nas lhas gnang bar bsams pa 'dis ni/ rdzas dang yo byad la sogs pa'i dri ma thams cad dag par 'gyur ro// dkyil 'khor mchod pa'i cho ga'o// lnga pa rdo rje slob dpon bdag 'jug bya ba ni/ sems bskyed pa nas rjes su gnang ba'i bar gyi cho ga ji lta bas dkyil 'khor la bdag gi blang zhing gnas skabs dang sbyar la rgyas bsdus ci rigs su byas te/ mthar bden pa'i byin brlabs bya ba ni/ nam mkha' skye ba mtshan ldan phyir// thog ma tha ma med pa'i mchog sems dpa'i rdo rje che rang bzhin// rdo rje sems dpar bdag bsgrubs mdzod// kun mchog dngos grub chen po ste// dbang phyug chen po lhag pa'i lha// rdo rje 'dzin pa kun gyi rgyal// mi 'gyur mchog tu bdag ༄༅// bsgrubs mdzod// nyes pa mi mnga' rtag pa khyod// 'dod chags kun gyi rjes chags pa// 'dod chags chen po dga' ba che// bcom ldan de nyid kyis grub mdzod// shin tu dag pa kun gyi mchog /gdod nas grol ba de bzhin gshegs// kun du bzang po kun bdag nyid// byang chub sems dpar bdag bsgrubs mdzod// dngos grub chen po kun gyi mchog /dbang phyug chen po lhag pa'i lha// grub pa'i rdo rje cher bstod pa// rdo rje snyems par bdag mdzod cig /sems can kun gyi yid khyab cing*// sems can kun gyi snying la zhugs// sems can kun gyi yab gyur cig /'dod chags dam tshig mchog gyur pa'o/ bden pa gang gis ye shes mchog /shes rab thabs bdag dkyil 'khor pa// bden pa de yis mgon bdag po// khyed kyis 'dod pa rab rdzogs mdzod// chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste// dag cing gsal la rnyog pa med// gzung du med cing brjod du med// rgyu dang las las kun du byung*// de bzhin nyid las nges par skyes/

bden pa de yis dkyil 'khor du// gzugs brnyan gsal bar slob ma ni// kun gyis dri ma med mthong shog /ces lan gsum du brjod do// slob dpon 'jug pa'o// drug pa slob ma 'jug pa ni bcu gsum ste/ dang po gdong bcing ba ni ras dmar po la sogs pas bkab ste 'byung po la gtor ma byin nas maṇ+ḍal phul te yon gyi mchog kyang phul nas gus pas thal mo sbyar te/ sdug pa'i slob ma la/ slob dpon gyis/ kye sdug pa khyed su yin zhes dri'o// des kyang kye bde ba chen po bdag ni skal ba bzang po'o// zhes brjod do// gnyis pas ni/ oṃ a kham̐ bi ra hūm̐ gis me tog gi phreng ba 'dzin du bcug ste/ dkyil 'khor gyi yol ba'i nang du bcug nas/ oṃ na ma sarba ta thā ga ta pu tsa pa ta na ya/ ad ma naṃ nir+ya ta ya mi bai ro tsa na pra bar ya mam̐/ de bzhin du a kro bh+ya/ rad na swā bha ba/ a mi de bā/ a mo ka sid dhi pra bar ta ya maṃ zhes phyag 'tshal la gral la 'khod do// gsum pa don dam du sems bskyed pa ni/ rang rang dang po'i mgon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis par bskyed pa'i snying khar kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi ngo bo/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya gang ba'i dbus su/ don dam byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa bsgoms te/ oṃ sarba yo ga tsi ta ud pa ta ya mi su ra ta sa ma ya stoṃ ho/ sidha badz+ra ya tha su kham̐/ zhes brjod do// bzhi pa dam tshig sgrag pa ni spros pa la dga' na sngar ltar da ma tshig dang sdom pa 'dzin du bcug nas/ khyod kyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mchog tu gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'di ma mthong pa dad pa med pa rnams la smra bar ma byed cig /ces brjod nas mgo thog du rdo rje bzung nas/ deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs su zhugs kyis

༄༅// ngas khyod la rdo rje'i ye shes bskyed par bya ste/ ye shes gang gis de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi ye shes kyang thob na dngos grub gzhan lta smos kyang ci dgos/ khyod kyis dkyil 'khor chen po ma mthong ba rnams la smra bar mi bya'o// gal te smras na dam tshig nyams par gyur ta re/ zhes brjod do// yang rdo rje snying khar bzung nas/ oṃ badz+ra sa ta hūm̐/ rdo rje sems dpa' de khyod kyi// snying la yang dag zhugs par gyur// gal te tshul 'di smras na ni// de ma thag tu dral te gshegs// zhes so// de nas bdud rtsi'i chu 'thung du gzhug te/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu// dam tshig 'das na bsreg par byed// dam tshig bsrungs na dngos grub ster// rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'thung shig /oṃ badz+ra ar mri ta ud ka tha thā/ slob dpon khyod kyi dam tshig ni/ deng phan chad kyi phyag na rdo rje nga yin gyis/ ngas 'di byos shig ces brjod pa gang yin pa de yang khyod kyis bya dgos so// khyod kyis nga la brnyas par ma byed cig /mi bde ba ma spangs par tshe'i dus byas nas dmyal bar ltung bar gyur ta re// zhes brjod do// lnga pa ye shes dbab pa ni slob ma de rnams snang ba mtha' yas su bsgom du bcug la/ spyi bor ha/ mgrin par a dmar po/ snying khar laṃ las sa'i dkyil 'khor gru bzhi pa'i dbus su hūm̐/ lte bar bam̐ las chu'i dkyil 'khor zlum po/ sum mdor raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po/ rkang pa'i 'og tu yam̐ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor gzhu lta bu/ de'i 'og tu dzhaṃ 'od 'bar ba g.yos nas dkyil 'khor rnams rim pas bskyod nas lus thams cad bde stong du gyur par bsgom zhing/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi byin brlabs 'od zer ltar dgug cing mos pa byas te/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis rlobs la/ rdo rje sems dpa' bdag la dbab par mdzod cig

/ces lan gsum du gsol ba gtab la/ badz+ra a be sha ya sto bha ya ra rwa ra/ tsa la ya tsa la hūm̐ ha a dzhā+oṃḥ zhes brjod cing gu gul dang byi la'i brun si la dang bcas pa'i bdug spos bsreg cing rol mo dang bcas pas bskul lo// phebs pa dang ti sta badz+ra zhes pas brtan par byas te/ gal te smra na lce la aḥbasgoms te smrar gzhug go /bab pas lus ngag yid gsum byin gyis rlob par 'gyur ro// drug pa snang ba brtag cing me tog dor ba ni/ dkyil 'khor la ltar bcug la/ kha dog ci ltar mthong dri'o// dkar po zhi ba/ ser po rgyas pa/ dmar po dbang*/ nag po drag po/ sna tshogs ni las thams cad pa'i ye shes 'grub po zhes bstan to/ de nas me tog dor ba ni/ yang dag pa'i dkyil 'khor du// bdag gis slob ma gzhug par bgyi// lha rnams rigs kyi rim ji bzhin// ji ltar bsod nams de bzhin shog /pra ti ts+tsha badz+ra ho zhes me tog gi phreng ba dor ro// gang la babs pa'i ༄༅// lha'i rigs so// phyi rol tu lhung na lan gsum du skyar ro// de la yang ma byung na skal ba med pas btang ngo*// bdun pa spyan dbye ba ni/ oṃ rdo rje sems dpa' deng khyod kyis// mig 'byed par ni brtson par mdzad// phye bas thams cad mthong 'gyur te// rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med/ oṃ tsa k+ṣu sa ma tsa k+ṣu bhi sho dha ya swa hā// zhes dbye'o// brgyad pa ni dkyil 'khor bstan te/ dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos// da ni dad pa rab tu bskyed// gsang sngags phyag rgya'i byin brlabs las// 'gro ba phun tshogs dngos grub kun/ thams cad 'di las 'byung bas na// dngos grub thob phyir dam tshig skyongs// thabs dang shes rab dbyer med pa'i// gsang sngags mnyam med bzlas par gyis// zhes brjod nas/ 'di ltar dkyil 'khor chos kyi dbyings mi mnyam pa med pas gru bzhi pa/ dran pa nye bar bzhag nas dbang po lnga'i bar dag pa'i sgo bzhi pa/

'phags lam brgyad kyi ka ba can byang chub kyi yan lag dag pa'i rta babs dang ldan pa/ ye shes lnga'i brtsig pa dang*/ 'dod yon dag pa'i snam bu dang bsdu ba'i pha gu dang*/ thabs shes rab kyi dra ba dang*/ dra ba phyed pa dang*/ dbang bcu'i ba gu li dang*/ dge ba'i bkra ma shi sha can/ tshad med pa'i ri dwags dang*/ chos kyi 'khor lo bum pa bzang po/ sa thams cad rdzogs pa'i dur khrod rdo rje me ri dang bcas pa ni dkyil 'khor gyi rang bzhin no/ de'i dbus na bcom ldan 'das kyi dkyil 'khor ni/ gzugs phung dag pa me long dang*/ zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i rnam dag rgyas par bstan par bya'o// dgu pa me tog gi dbang ni/ sngar gyi me tog lha de nyid kyi ngo bor bstims te mgo la bzhag nas/ oṃ pra ti gh+ri na twa sa mi mam̐/ sarba sa ma ya sto ma hā sa la/ zhes dbang sbyin no// de rnams ni slob ma dkyil 'khor du gzhug pa'o/ da ni dbang bzhi ste/ thog mar bum pa'i dbang la yang gnyis te/ rig pa'i dbang lnga dang*/ bdag po slob dpon gyi dbang ngo*// dang po la yang*/ gsol ba gdab pa dang*/ rig pa'i dbang lnga/ me long dang drug ste/ maṇ+ḍal phul nas gsol ba gdab pa ni/ byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la// dbang mchog dam pa stsal ba ltar// bdag kyang skyob pa'i don gyi phyir// nam mkha' rdo rje deng bdag stsol/ zhes lan gsum du brjod la/ de ma thag tu rdo rje slob dpon gyis/ reg rdo rje dang snyoms par zhugs pa'i 'od zer gyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad bskul nas bum pa'i chu'i rang bzhin du gyur par bsgoms te/ slob ma mi bskyod pa'i gzugs su bsams pa chu dbang sbyin te/ gsang gsum dam tshig las byung pa'i/ ye shes bdud rtsi dri ma med// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// mi bskyod pa yis dbang bskur ro/ oṃ badz+ra a dar sha dzña na a bhi shin tsa hūm̐/ zhes brjod la zhe sdang ༄༅// rnam par dag par gyur par lta'o// de nas dbu rgyan dar dpyangs dang bcas pa la rin chen 'byung ldan yab yum du bsgoms la snga ma bzhin sangs rgyas thams cad gzhug cing dbu rgyan du bskur la/

mgo la bcings te/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rgyal srid che// dbu rgyan rin chen dam pa ste// rin chen 'byung ldan mchog 'gro ba// rdzogs sangs rgyas su dbang bskur ro// oṃ badz+ra sa man ta dzña na rad na ma ta ni hūm̐ a bhi shin ts+tsha/ zhes slob ma nga rgyal dag pa rin chen 'byung ldan du bya'o// de nas rdo rje de la 'od dpag med yab yum sngar ltar bkug cing lag tu byin te/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rdo rje'i dbang*// mi phyed rdo rje 'od gsal ba// dam chos 'byung ba'i sgor zhugs pa// rdo rje chos kyis dbang bskur ro// oṃ badz+ra pra ti a bhi k+ṣa dzña na badz+ra a bhi shin tsā/ zhes 'dod chags dag pa 'od dpag med du bya'o// de nas dril bu don yod grub pa yab yum du byas la sngar ltar g.yon du byin la/ thabs dang shes rab ldan pa yis// 'gro don mnyam med byed pa dang*// mchod pa'i las kun rdzogs byed pa// rdo rje las kyi dbang bskur ro// oṃ badz+ra kri ta a nud ta na dzña na pa te a bhi shin tsā/ zhes phrag dog dag pa don yod grub par bya'o// de nas rnam par snang mdzad snga ma ltar dmigs nas rigs dang mthun pa'i ming gi dbang byin te/ rdo rje ming gi dbang bskur bas// byang chub snying po'i bar du ni// cis kyang mi shigs mi g.yo ba// rdo rje'i ming da nga rab tu grags/ oṃ shrī bhi sho ta dhar ma dha du dzña na na ma a shin tsā/ dpal zhe sdang rdo rje mi bskyod/ rang byung zhes pa dang*/ gti mug /rtag pa/ snang mdzad shar/ nga rgyal/ yon tan/ rin chen/ lho/ 'dod chags/ bde chen/ dpag med/ nub/ phrag dog /las kyi/ don yod byang ngo*/ bud med la ni/ reg rdo rje ma la sogs pa rnams gdags so// gti mug rnam par dag pa'i rang bzhin du bya'o// de nas me long la shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma phab la bsgyur te/ me long bstan la/ brjod dang gzung 'dzin spangs pa yi/ dag cing gsal la dri ma med// me long nang gi gzugs brnyan bzhin// rang lha'i gzugs ni shes par gyis// oṃ pra ti bā bhim pa a dar sha bā ma a bhi shin tsa/

zhes brtan par bya'o// de ni snga ma rnams la rgyas gdab pa ste/ rig pa'i dbang gi cho ga'o// rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang la/ gsol ba gdab pa dang*/ sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig gsum sbyin pa dang*/ dngos dang*/ lus dkyil 'khor du bstan pa dang*/ rjes su gnang ba dang lnga las/ dang po ni maṇ+ḍal dang yon gyi mchog phul nas/ sngar gyi byang chub rdo rje zhes pa'am/ yang na/ gang gi bdag ni khyod drin las// rang dang gzhan don nus gyur pa// rdo rje slob dpon gyi ni dbang*/ ༄༅// thugs rje'i gter kye bdag la stsol// zhes lan gsum mo/ de nas dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs su/ seng ge'i khri pad ma 'dab ma brgyad pa/ gdugs la sogs pas brgyan pa la slob ma bzhag ste/ gnyis pa dam tshig sbyin pa ni/ hūm̐ las byung pa'i rdo rje lag tu byin la// thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni// rdo rje sems dpa' rgyal po che// kun du bzang po kun bdag nyid// rdo rje snyems tshul bdag po'i bdag /'di ni thugs kyi dam tshig go /de nas a las byung ba'i dril bu byin la/ 'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// shes rab dbyangs kyi rjes 'gror bshad// khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang*/ byang chub rdo rjer rgyal ba bzhed// srid pa ngo bo nyid kyis dag /ngo bo nyid kyis srid bral byas// rang bzhin dag pa'i sems dpa' ni// srid pa'i mchog ni mdzad pa yin// zhes gsung gi dam tshig go /de nas oṃ de'i lus la bstims la/ snying po bsnyen pa sogs spyad pas// phyag rgya chen por byin brlabs la// gzugs sogs 'dod pa'i dam tshig gis// gsang sngags ma tshang med par bzlas// rang gi rig pa'i ngo bo nyid/ phyogs bcu dus gsum bzhugs pa ste// rang gi lha yi sbyor ba yis// bdag dang gzhan la mchod par bya// dka' thub sdom pa mi bzad pas// bsten dang mi snang mngon shes dang*// mkha' la rgyu dang lus ngag yid/

las byung dngos grub 'grub mi 'gyur// de bas sangs rgyas sems dpa' mchog /sngags kyi spyod mchog spyod pa rnams// 'dod pa thams cad bsten pa yis// chos kyi yi ge mchog brnyes so// bde dang sdug bsngal bde bdag min// 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga rnams bsten// ye shes don gnyer 'dod chags can// sbyor bas bsgrubs na myur du grub// sku gsung thugs ni yang dag 'grub// gang gzhan dman par bshad pa ni/ sngags kyi bzlas pas 'grub 'gyur ba// sku gsung thugs ni bsgoms pas so// zhes bya ba ni sku'i dam tshig go /gsum pa dngos gzhi'i ni slob ma rdo rje sems dpa'i nga rgyal bsgom du bcug la/ slob dpon sbyor ba gsum rdzogs par bsgoms pas sangs rgyas thams cad bskul nas lha mo rnams kyis dbang bskur bar dmigs te/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ni// khams gsum po yis phyag byas la// gsang ba gsum gyi gnas las byung*// sangs rgyas kun gyis sbyin par bya// zhes brjod cing sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mnga' bdag tu gyur par bsgoms te slob ma la me tog gtor te/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭa badz+ra swā hā/ zhes pa dang*/ mchod pa lngas kyang mchod do// de nas rdo rje'i brtul shugs kyang sbyin te/ 'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// phyag na rdo rje'i lag na 'dug /khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang*// phyag na rdo rje'i brtul shugs brtan// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ༄༅// sidhi badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭa/ e shan dan dha ra ya mi hi hi hi hi hūm̐/ zhes brjod la rdo rje byin te/ khyod ni ming de dang ldan pa'i rdo rje slob dpon du gyur te/ theg pa chen po dbugs dbyung bar 'gyur to/ bzhi pa lus maṇ+ḍal du bstan pa ni/ 'di ltar dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs kyi chos rnams te phung po dang khams dang skye mched lha dang ye shes kyi ngo bo yin te/ gzugs phung me long rnam snang mdzad// tshor ba mnyam nyid rin chen 'byung*// 'du shes sor rtog 'od dpag med// 'du byed bya grub don yod grub// rnam shes chos dbyings mi bskyod pa// sa chu me rlung khams bzhi po// spyan ma ma ma gos dkar sgrol// tshad med rnam pa bzhir shes bya// gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya ni// gzugs kyi rdo rje la sogs yin// mig ni sa yi snying po ste// rna ba phyag na rdo rje'o// sna la nam mkha'i snying po ste// lce la 'jig rten dbang phyug go

/yid ni 'jam pa'i dbyangs yin te// lus ni sgrib pa rnam sel yin// chos dang rtsa rnams byams pa'o// nam mkha'i tshig rnams kun tu bzang*// lag pa g.yas g.yon kha gsang pa// gshin rje gshed dang gzhan mi thub// rta mgrin bdud rtsi 'khyil pa ste// bsdu ba bzhi yi rang bzhin no// dpung pa pus mo g.yas g.yon dang*// spyi gtsug rkang mthil gnas rnams dang*// rnam shes drug gi ngo bo ni// mi g.yo 'dod pa'i rgyal po dang*// dbyug sngon gtsug gtor stobs chen bsgyur// gnod mdzes yin te ye shes dngos// zad dang mi skye shes pa'o// zhes byung ba 'dir bsdus te bstan pa'o// lnga pa rjes gnang ni/ ngo bo nyid kyis sems can rnams// ji lta ji ltar 'dul 'gyur ba// de lta de ltar chags la sogs// gtsang bas sems can don bya'o// nyin re bzhin du thun bzhi ru// ting 'dzin gsum gyi sbyor ldan pas// gyur nas thun mong mchog rnams kyi// dngos grub thob pa bsgrub par bya// mi snang ba na stong yin te// mngon shes ldan pa stong gnyis yin// rig pa 'dzin pa stong gsum ste/ rdo rje can ni 'gro kun bdag /zhi dang rgyas sogs las gang dang*// de las gzhan pa ci 'dod pa/ 'khor lo rjes mnyam sbyor ba yin// bsgrubs na myur du 'grub par 'gyur// zhes gsungs pas khyod kyis dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i sgo nas dbang bskur ba dang rgyud nyan pa dang ston pa dang las thams cad bsgrub pas sems can gyi don bya'o// 'dir oṃ badz+ra dh+rig hūm̐ la sogs pa'i sngags kyi rjes gnang byas na yang 'thad do// rdo rje slob dpon du dbang bskur ba'i cho ga'o// byang chub sems dpa'i 'grel pa gsum na rdo rje slob dpon dbang bzhi ka'i rjes su bya bar gsungs so// 'dir ni phreng ba chu dang cod pan dang*// rdo rje dril bu'i ming dang ni// me long slob dpon rjes gnang ste// zhes dgu po 'di ni rdo rje 'chang chen po'i sprul pa'i

༄༅// dkyil 'khor du rig pa'i dbang bskur ba'o zhes gsungs so// gnyis pa gsang ba'i dbang la gsum ste/ sngon 'gro dang*/ dngos gzhi dang*/ rjes so/ dang po ni/ bdud rtsi lnga dang bcas pas byugs pa'i sar mchod pa bshams te/ phyi nang gi mchod pa rnams bla ma'i maṇ+ḍal la phul nas/ maṇ+ḍal rin po che rnams dang bcas pas gsol ba gdab pa/ rdo rje sems khyod sangs rgyas rnams kyi bde ba bsgrub pa ste// rnam dag byang chub sems dpa' rgya chen sras su bcas pa rnams// yun ring stong nyid bsgoms pas dub pa bdag cag la// dga' ba yid 'ong bde ba chen po nyid kyis mnyes par mdzod/ kye 'dod chags de ni dri med kun du bzang po'i spyod pa ste// dag pa'i 'dod chags rdo rjes dam tshig las ni gsal mdzad na// dka' ba rnam pa drug pos spyod pas shin tu gdungs pa yi// rab tu dgyes dbang 'dod pa'i bde ba nyid kyis rdzogs par mdzod// byang chub sems ni rin chen 'bar phyung bas// ma lus rgyal ba rnams ni lus skams la// rnam dag rdo rje las byung ye shes chus// dri med rin chen spyi dbab dbang bskur mdzod/ mnyam dang mi mnyam 'dod chags tshul dag pas// pad mo'i gnas su rdo rje mdzod gtong pa// sna tshogs sems dpa' sems can brlag gyur pa// sbyor ba gzhan med ma thogs bshad par gsol// rdo rje sems khyod dbang mchog bde bar byed/ rdo rje pad ma phye ba'i tshul gyis sbyor// rgyal ba kun gyi gzugs sku rab ston pa// thams cad bde bsgrub nyid kyis bdag dgyes mdzod// zhes brjod nas/ dngos gzhi ni bla mas yid skyes reg rdo rje la sogs pa'i sbyor ba'i ting nge 'dzin las byung ba'i byang chub kyi sems thod pa'am dung chos su bzhag pa rol mo dang bcas pas sbyin no// 'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// dam tshig chen po rmad byung ba/ khams lnga las byung bcud kyis len// bde ba chen po myang bar gyis// 'das pa'i rdo rje 'chang ba yis// rgyal sras ji ltar dbang bskur ba// byang chub sems kyi chu yis ni// bu khyod de bzhin dbang bskur ro// zhes brjod cing*/

slob mas lus kyi lha thams cad bde ba chen por gyur pa'i bsam pas/ a ho ma hā su kha zhes btung bar bya'o// rjes ni bla ma la bstod pa 'dis bstod do// khong stong khyod kyi sku la med// sha dang rus pa khrag kyang med// nam mkha' la ni 'ja' tshon ltar// khyod kyi sku ni ston par mdzad// sku la bsnyung med mi gtsang med// bkres dang skom pa 'byung med kyang*// khyod ni 'jig rten rjes 'jug phyir// 'jig rten bya ba ston par mdzad// chu zla bzhin du bzung du med// chos rnams kun la gnas pa med// nga rgyal med cing rmongs mi mnga'// dmigs med khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// gshegs dang bzhugs dang de bzhin gzims// spyod lam

༄༅// dag cing thams cad du// khyod ni rtag tu mnyam 'jog pa// dmigs med khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes bstod par bya'o// gsang ba'i dbang ngo*// gsum pa shes rab ye shes kyi dbang la yang gsum/ bstod cing gsol ba gdab pa dang*// dngos gzhi dang rjes gnang ngo*// dang po ni yang maṇ+ḍal dang mchod pa thams cad kyis mchod nas/ bstod pa ni/ khams gsum las ni rnam grol zhing*/ nam mkha' dang ni mnyam gyur la// 'dod pa rnams kyis ma gos pa// dmigs med khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// phung po rnams dang khams rnams dang*// skye mched rnams la mi brten cing*// phyin ci log las rnam grol ba// dmigs med khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// rnam rtog med cing kun rtog med// thugs ni rab tu mi gnas pa// bsam gyis mi khyab pa yi thugs// dmigs med khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// ji ltar nam mkha' gnas med cing*/ spros pas gos pa med pa ltar// mkha' dang mnyam pa'i thugs mnga' ba// dmigs med khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes bstod nas gsol ba gdab pa ni/ kun mkhyen ye shes phung po can// srid pa'i 'khor lo rnam sbyong ba// deng 'dir bshad pa'i rin chen gyis// gtso bos bdag la bka' drin rtsol// khyod zhabs pad ma spangs nas ni// gtso bo gzhan ni skyabs ma mchis// 'gro ba'i dpa' bo mthu chen gyis// de bas blo mchog nye bar mdzad// thams cad stong ba'i rang bzhin can// mngon par byang chub lta bar 'tshal// zhes lan gsum mo// dngos gzhi ni 'dir las dang chos dang dam tshig gi phyag rgya ni shes rab ste/ yid las byung ba reg bya rdo rje ma sgyu ma dang mtshungs pa/ slob ma zhe sdang rdo rje dmigs pa'am/ yang na rang rigs kyi yum bsgom pa la sogs pa'i stobs kyis sbyin te/ lha mo phyag rgya chen po 'di// dpag med bde ba rab ster ma// bu yis kun nas blangs nas ni// bla na med pa'i mchod pa gyis/ zhes brjod pa ji ltar de kho na'i mchod pa'i skabs kyi ting nge 'dzin bstan te bdag byin gyis brlab pa'i rim pa'am/

sgyu ma'i dpe bcu gnyis kyis nye bar mtshon pa'i kun rdzob kyi bden pa'i man ngag bstan par bya'o// yang na dam tshig gi phyag rgya nang gi mngon par byang chub pa'i 'bar 'dzag bstan no// rjes gnang ni/ de ring phan chad bu khyod kyis/ ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar// rmi lam bzhin du sems can gyi// bla na med pa'i don byos shig /rig pa 'di ni dor byas nas// thabs gzhan gyis ni sangs mi rgya// brtul shugs rnams kyi mchog gi mchog /rig pa'i brtul shugs bu yis spyod/ zhes bstan no// dbang gsum pa'o// dbang bzhi pa ni gsum ste/ gsol ba gdab pa dang*/ dngos dang*/ dbang rnams kyi rjes su gnang pa'i dam tshig bstan pa'o// dang po ni/ ༄༅// las dang skye las rnam grol zhing*// snang ba gsum po spangs pa yi// mngon par byang chub mthong bar ni// mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo// sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes che// de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas// ye shes rdo rje bla na med// mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo// thog mtha' med cing zhi ba dang*// nyon mongs thams cad rnam sbyong zhing*// lus dang ngag dang sems sbyong ba// rdo rje chen po bdag 'tshal lo// zhes gsol ba btab nas/ bla mas dbang bzhi pa don dam pa'i byang chub kyi sems kyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas/ ril por 'dzin pa dang*/ rjes su gzhig pa'i rnal 'byor bstan par bya'o// de yang lus ngag yid gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku dang*/ rdo rje'i sngags dang*/ chu zla lta bu'i thugs bde ba chen po'i rnal 'byor la gnas nas sems can thams cad kyi don byed pa dang*/ chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin rang gi sems spros pa thams cad dang bral ba 'od gsal ba phung po dang khams dang skye mched kyi spros pa thams cad dang bral ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi don dam pa'i byang chub kyi sems rdo rje mngon sum du bya ba ni dbang bzhi pa'o// rigs kyi bu khyed rnams kyis de rtogs par bya ba'i phyir/

rim pa lnga'i gdams ngag las shes par bya'o// zhes bstan to// de ltar dbang gong ma thob nas thun mong ma yin pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa rnams kyis bsgrub pa ni 'di rnams so// dbang bskur 'di ni ji lta bar// byang chub spyod gzhan de bzhin du// dge ba'i tshul ni gzhan gsungs pa/ sangs rgyas kun sogs thob mi 'gyur// bu yis dam tshig bsrung ba dang*// rtag tu sdom pa bskyang bar bya// bcu phyed sgron ma mi 'chi spyad// dam tshig gzhan yang bsrung ba ni// dkon mchog gnod pa gzhom bya ste/ shes rab thams cad spyad par bya// gzhan gyi nor yang blang bar bya// rtag tu rdzun du smra bar bya/ zhes bya ba thun mong ma yin pa lnga'o// rdo rje theg pa'i phas pham pa dang 'dra ba'i rtsa ba'i dam tshig nyams na ltung bar 'gyur ba bcu bzhi yod de/ slob dpon la ni brnyas pa dang*// bde gshegs bka' las 'das pa dang*// sdang pas yun gyi sngags mi smra// byams pa chen po spong ba dang*// byang chub sems ni 'dor ba dang*// theg pa gsum la smod pa dang*// skal min gsang ba sgrogs pa dang*// rgyal ba'i bdag nyid phung po smod// dag pa'i chos la yid gnyis za/ gdug la byams dang chags bral dang*// chos la gnyis su 'byed pa dang*// dad pa'i sems can rab tu smod// dam tshig rnyed tshe ji srid pa'i// brtags pa'i shes rab smod pa ste// sngags pas 'di dag byas na ni// kha na ma tho sbom por 'gyur// rtsa ba'i ltung ba yin par bshad// nyin dang mtshan du lan ༄༅// gsum du// bsngags pas rtag tu bsam par bya// gzhan yang yan lag dam tshig ni// dam med rig ma mi bsten cing*// tshogs kyi 'khor lor rtsod mi bya// ma gsungs pa yi rig ma la// dam tshig bdud rtsi mi blang zhing*// gsang chos dus ldan bstan par bya// co 'dri bre mo'i gtam mi bya// nyan thos nang du zhag bdun min// rnal 'byor ye shes mi shes par// rdo rje 'dzin par khas mi blang*// dus min gsang chos bstan pa min// gsang bas 'di dag nyams mi bya// zad pas grub pa yod min te// nad dang sdug bsngal rab tu 'phel// de bas dam tshig bus bsrungs shig

/zhes sdoms pa sbyin no// dam tshig sdom pa grub pa 'di// khyod kyis rtag tu bzung bar bya// sangs rgyas kun gyis mthun par gsungs// dam tshig bdag gi bka' yin no// byang chub sems ni btang mi bya// phyag rgya rdo rje gang yin pa'o// gang zhig bskyed pa tsam gyis ni/ sangs rgyas nyid du the tshom med// dam pa'i chos ni mi spang zhing*// nam yang dor bar mi bya'o// mi shes pa'am rmongs pa yi// tshul chen bstan par mi bya'o// bdag nyid yongs su spangs nas ni/ dka' thub kyis ni ma gdungs par// ci bde bar ni bde ba zung*// 'di ni ma byon rdzogs sangs rgyas// rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya rnams// nam yang dor bar mi bya zhing*// slob dpon smad par mi bya'o// 'di ni sangs rgyas kun dang 'dra// sangs rgyas kun mtshungs bla ma yi// slob dpon la ni gang smod pa// des ni sangs rgyas kun smad pas/ rtag tu sdug bsngal thob gyur te// rims dang dgra dang dug dang nad// mkha' 'gro rnams kyis 'tshe ba dang*// gdon dang log 'dren gtums po yis// bsad nas sems can dmyal bar ltung*// de bas nan tan thams cad kyis// rdo rje slob dpon blo gros che// dge ba rtag tu mi bcom pas// bla ma la ni gus bcas yon// rjes su mthun par sbyin par bya// des ni rims sogs gnod pa rnams// phyir zhing 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro// rtag tu rang gi dam tshig bsrungs// rtag tu de bzhin gshegs pa mchod// rtag tu bla ma la yang 'bul// 'di ni sangs rgyas kun dang 'dra// de phyir sangs rgyas thams cad la// rtag tu byin pa nyid du gyur// de byin bsod nams tshogs yin te// tshogs las dngos grub mchog tu 'gyur// zhes gdams pa sbyin no// dbang bzhi pa'o// de nas bum pa dang 'brel ba'i lung bstan pa dang*/ gsang ba dang 'brel ba'i dbugs dbyung ba dang*/ shes rab dang 'brel ba'i gzengs bstod pa rnams bya ste/

yi ge a las slob dpon shākya thub pa'i cha lugs su bsgyur te/ g.yon chos gos 'dzin pa/ g.yas pa lung ston pa'i phyag rgya mgo bor bzhag ste/ oṃ nga yis 'di ltar lung bstan te// rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs// srid pa'i mchog ni ༄༅// grub pa'i phyir// srid pa'i ngan 'gro nyid las bton// kye de bzhin gshegs pa rdo rje che ge mo zhes bya'o/ sid dhi bhur bū wa swāhā/ 'dis sangs rgyas thams cad kyis lung bstan par 'gyur ro// dbugs dbyung ba ni/ mchog gsang dkyil 'khor dam pa 'dir// mthong pa'am ni zhugs gyur pas// sdig pa kun las nges par grol// khyed rnams de nyid legs par gnas// bde chen theg pa 'di la ni// slar khyod 'chi ba yong med de// mi thub pa dang mi sod pas// cis kyang mi 'jigs dga' bar gyis// srid pa shin tu dag pa'i phyir// srid pa'i sdug bsngal las khyod 'das// ston pa mchog tu gyur pa yin// srid pa gtan du yod ma yin// zhes brjod do// gzengs bstod pa ni/ gang phyir 'di ni legs gnas pa// deng khyod skye ba 'bras bur bcas// lha dang dam pa mnyam pa ru// deng khyod gyur pa the tshom med// sangs rgyas rdo rje 'dzin bcas par// kun gyis deng khyod dbang bskur bas// khams gsum gyi ni rgyal po che// rgyal po'i bdag por bstan pa yin// de ring bdud las rgyal gyur te// grong khyer mchog tu rab tu zhugs// khyed rnams kyi ni sangs rgyas nyid// de nyid thob par the tshom med// de ltar yid ni rab dang rdo rje nyid du gyis// rang gi dam tshig mi zad bde skyid brtan par gyis// deng ni 'gro la myur bde rdo rje sems dpa' dang*// rab tu mnyam zhing rtag pa nyid du rtogs par gyis/ zhes brtan par bya'o// de nas yang sngar bstan pa'i rdo rje'i rjes gnang yang sbyin no// de nas bla ma la phyag 'tshal te/

gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa// de bzhin du ni bgyid par 'tshal// zhes bya'o// de nas rin chen khyim dang glang po rta// yul dang mal stan rnams dang ni// bran dang bran mo chung ma sdug /bu mo shin du yid 'ong dang*// gang gis bdag kyang dbul bya na// lhag ma rnams kyang smos ci dgos// zhes pas mnyes par bya'o// de ni dbang bzhi pa yon tan dang bcas pa'i cho ga'o// sbyin bsreg ni kho bos 'od kyi snye ma'i bsdus par bstan pas 'dir ma bris so// rab tu gnas pa ni bum pa gnyis la brten par bshad pa'i rim pas bya'o// thams cad stong pa zab cing phra bas na// rtog ge yul min 'khrul pas shes mi nus// des na de la 'jug par bya ba'i phyir// rim gnyis thabs kyi sngon 'gro'i cho ga yin// dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga slob dpon bdag nyid chen po 'phags pa klu grub/ bde bar gshegs pas mdo rgyud du ma nas lung bstan pa/ rig pa'i mchog rma bya chen mo grub pa'i 'khor los bsgyur ba/ cig tu dpal sgra gcan bzang po sa ra ha pa'i bka' lung spyi bos nod pa rdo rje theg pa'i don gzigs par mdzad pa dang*/ rgyud na bzhugs pa'i tshig 'ga' yar dang*/ bla ma dam pa ༄༅// rnams kyi man ngag dang bcas pa 'di/ rang byung rdo rje'i ming can gyis lhag pa'i bsam pa rnam par dag pas bsdus pa'o/ bla med rgyud rgyal gsang ba 'dus pa yis// gsal byed rgyud rgyal rdo rje phreng ba las// rnam bshad rgyud kyi dbang gi cho ga 'di// gsal byas rgyud kyi don la 'jug gyur cig /nyes par gyur gang bla ma mkha' 'gro la// bzod par gsol bas dngos grub rtsal du gsol// deng sang dus na mkhas par rlom pa rnams// bla ma'i gdams pa rgyud pa mi shes par// rang bzo'i cho ga cig gi lag len byed// de dag sel phyir rang byung rdo rjes sbyar/ 'gro ba'i don rgya cher grub par gyur cig
